description: QR code error correction levels. A higher level survives more damage or occlusion (for example a logo overlaid on the code) at the cost of encoding capacity.

examples.title: Use QRErrorCorrectionLevel
examples.code:
<TmQRCode Value="https://example.test"
          ErrorCorrectionLevel="QRErrorCorrectionLevel.H" />

@* H tolerates the most damage — pick it when overlaying a logo *@
